text: I still haven't told my parents I changed my major three times. I'm supposed to graduate this year but I'm only a sophomore.
I'm in love with my best friend but she's getting married in June. I'm the maid of honor and it's killing me.
I stole a pen from the office and I've been using it for a year. It's the best pen I've ever had.
I pretend to be busy on weekends so I don't have to hang out with anyone. I just want to play video games in peace.
I once accidentally dented a car in a parking lot and didn't leave a note. I still feel bad every time I see a similar car.
I've been skipping the gym for three months but I still post 'workout' selfies from my old gallery.
I'm 30 and I still sleep with a nightlight because I'm terrified of the dark.
I secretly hope my ex's new relationship fails. I know it's toxic but I can't help it.
I lied on my resume about knowing Excel. Every day at work is a struggle of Google and panic.
I ate my roommate's expensive leftovers and blamed it on the neighbor's cat that visited.
I actually enjoyed the movie everyone said was terrible. I've watched it five times now.
I've been secretly writing fanfiction about my coworkers. If they found out, I'd have to move to another country.
I haven't washed my favorite hoodie in months because it still smells like my ex.
I sometimes talk to myself in the mirror like I'm giving a TED talk.
I'm pretty sure I saw a UFO last night but I'm too scared to tell anyone they'll think I'm crazy.
I donated to a charity just because my crush was watching. I'm not as generous as they think.
I find it hard to be happy for my brother's success because I've always been the 'striving' one.
I once deleted a friend's saved game because I was jealous of their progress.
I'm addicted to reading drama subreddits. My own life is boring so I live through others.
I finally quit my soul-crushing job yesterday without a backup plan. I've never felt more relieved.
I still haven't returned a library book from 2018. The fine is probably more than the book's worth.
I pretend to like coffee because it makes me look more professional at meetings. I hate it.
I track my ex's Spotify activity to see what kind of mood they're in. I know I need to stop.
I feel like a failure compared to my peers on LinkedIn, even though I'm doing okay.
I once sent a 'risky text' and then immediately turned my phone off for 24 hours.
